claim.text: The struck vehicle became a hazard at 2.7213 s by entering the ego lane.
The system took 1.4441 s to notice the vehicle, above the 0.30 s perception threshold.
The command interval was 0.0513 s, below the 0.10 s command threshold.
The brake actuation interval was 0.30 s, below the 0.45 s actuation threshold.
The brake log is complete, so the timing evidence is not inconclusive for missing brake data.
With nominal perception 0.20 s, nominal command 0.05 s and nominal tau 0.35 s, the counterfactual avoided contact.
Both witness observations report no turn signal from the other vehicle.
Perception is the primary contributing factor because it is the interval exceeding its threshold while command and actuation remain within theirs, and nominal timing avoids contact.
